text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League clash between Newcastle United and Manchester United.

Newcastle come into this game off the back of a frustrating draw against Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League, with Kylian Mbappe's controversial stoppage-time penalty denying them a win at the Parc des Princes.
As a result, a place in the knockout stages is no longer in their hands.
As for the Premier League, the Magpies bounced back from their away defeat against Bournemouth to thump Chelsea 4-1 at St.
James' Park, with Eddie Howe's men winning their last five at home.
Losing just one of their previous nine outings in the top flight, Newcastle are only a point behind United and will climb up to fifth position with a victory.
United are one of the form sides in the Premier League and have won five of their six most recent games, keeping a clean sheet in their last three matches.
Erik ten Hag's side thrashed Everton at Goodison Park in their previous top-flight match, with Alejandro Garnacho's stunning overhead kick helping them on their way to a 3-0 win.
However, like Newcastle, their fate in the Champions League is up in the air after dropping points away from home.
They had to settle for a 3-3 draw against Galatasaray and are at the bottom of Group A with one match remaining.
Having already been beaten 3-0 by the Magpies in the EFL Cup, United's preparations for this game have also been hindered by the weather, with the team flight getting cancelled.
As a result, they have had to take a coach instead.
United will take encouragement from their away form in the Premier League, triumphing in their last four on their travels.
Howe names the same Newcastle team that drew with PSG in the Champions League in midweek.
Hall could not play against parent club Chelsea in the Magpies’ previous Premier League outing but is back on the bench today.
United make four alterations to the team that drew 3-3 with Galatasaray in their last match.
Dalot replaces Lindelof in the defence and starts at left-back, meaning that Shaw moves inside to partner Maguire at centre-back.
Mainoo comes in for Amrabat in the midfield, with winger Antony and striker Hojlund also dropping onto the bench.
Rashford appears on the wing and Martial leads the attack up front.
Newcastle won this exact fixture 2-0 in April – they’ve not beaten United in consecutive league games since October 1972.
Both teams are now on the pitch and are ready to get the game started.
Newcastle get this Premier League clash under way.
Isak with the first kick.
Gordon collects the ball in the middle of the pitch and drives forward before looking for Almiron down the right.
Dalot gets ahead of him and pokes the ball back to Onana, who is immediately put under pressure by the home crowd.
Joelinton gets into a battle with McTominay next to the left corner flag in United's half.
He uses his movement to put the Scotland international on the floor before going around him, but Maguire is there to clear it away.
Livramento has possession on the left and he flashes a cross into the box.
Dalot jumps for it but he cannot get there, with the ball going just behind Almiron, who is forced to recycle it.
Isak is dropping deep to receive possession.
The striker is not put under any pressure and he slides the ball down the left to Livramento, who dribbles past Rashford before winning a corner.
Trippier's inswinging corner from the left causes panic in United's box, with Onana running off his line but missing the ball completely.
Dalot reacts quickly to clear the ball up the pitch.
Isak has his head in his hands.
Schar has the ball inside United's half and he chips a pass into the path of the striker.
Isak is free, but his touch lets him down, with United back in possession.
Onana and Dalot race towards a loose ball in Newcastle's box, with the right-back getting there first.
He attempts to clear the ball away, but it hits his own arm and goes towards the goal.
He then gets it out with the second attempt.
CHANCE! United have their first opportunity of the match.
Fernandes has the ball just inside his own half and he slides a perfect throughball down the left to Garnacho.
He beats the offside trap and gets behind Trippier, but his low shot towards the near post is saved by the foot of Pope.
Dalot finds Garnacho in the box.
The winger drives towards the byline before cutting a pass back to the edge of the box.
Wan-Bissaka is there, with the right-back shifting the ball onto his right foot before having a low effort blocked by Joelinton.
BLOCK! Isak gets down the right side of the box after some neat possession play from the home side.
He attempts to go past Shaw, but the defender tracks him all the way and blocks his strike from close range.
SAVE! Onana makes a huge stop.
Trippier collects a loose pass on the right and slides a brilliant ball down the right side of the box to Joelinton.
He cuts it back to Miley, who forces the goalkeeper into a diving save down to his right.
Livramento makes the most of the space that Rashford left on the wing, with the full-back driving forward before cutting into the box.
He looks to find space for a shot but is tackled by Maguire, with Guimaraes lashing a shot well off target moments later.
BLOCK! What an intervention from Maguire.
United fail to clear a cross from the right out of the box, with the ball dropping to Isak in the middle.
His shot looks to be heading on target, but the heel of Maguire turns it behind for a corner.
Schar gets on the end of the following corner from the right and hooks the ball back into the middle.
Lascelles gets there first, but he heads over from close range.
Newcastle will be looking to achieve something they haven’t in over a century.

Having won 2-0 in the Premier League in April and 3-0 in the League Cup last month, Newcastle are looking to win three consecutive meetings with Manchester United in all competitions for the first time since January 1922.
They have started this match brilliantly.
Almiron shows his speed and spins past Mainoo in the midfield.
He has options to his left and right, deciding to slide a pass towards Gordon, but he doesn't put enough power on it and Maguire makes a crucial interception.
Livramento has done a lot of running down the left, but this time shows his quality with a thumping pass towards Gordon.
He gets towards the byline and has Joelinton making a darting run, but his cutback is poked away.
United cannot get out of their own half, with Newcastle completely dominating the match.
Guimaraes uses his body to roll past his marker and finds Miley on the wing, but his cross deflects behind for a corner.
United have a free-kick in a crossing position after Martial is fouled on the left.
Fernandes and Shaw are over it, with the cross from the latter going straight into the gloves of Pope.
The home fans then unleash a loud cheer as the pressure on their goal is gone.
Mainoo has been quiet in this match but he does well to flick a pass down the right and over to Rashford.
The winger gets there before it goes out for a goal-kick and flashes a cross into the box, with Trippier heading it away from Garnacho.
Isak has possession on the edge of the box, with Maguire standing just ahead of him.
He tries to use the centre-back as a shield, curling a low shot around him and towards the bottom corner, but his effort goes wide.
Dalot plays a pass inside to Fernandes, who chips a smart pass down the left of the box to Wan-Bissaka.
He attempts to send a first-time cross into a dangerous area, but it rolls back harmlessly to Pope.
Newcastle come forward with pace.
Miley finds Almiron down the right, with the Paraguay international moving inside and curling a shot over.
Schar is unchanged in possession and he decides to drive out of the defence with the ball.
He arrives at the edge of the box before being fouled by Maguire.
He is furious that a foul is given, but the hosts have a free-kick in a shooting opportunity.
BAR! Trippier cannot get closer to scoring than that.
He hesitates to take the free-kick with the United wall moving forward.
When he eventually takes it, his whipped effort crashes against the bar, with Onana reacting quickly to claim the loose ball.

Newcastle kept a clean sheet in both Premier League meetings with Manchester United last season – they’ve not gone three league games in a row without conceding against the Red Devils since November 1897 in the second tier.
They have only conceded two shots in this half, with the last one coming in the 13th minute.
CLOSE! Maguire is shouting at his defence after he almost conceded an own goal.
Livramento is being given plenty of space to attack down the left, with the former Southampton man darting forward down the wing.
He looks to curl a low cross into the path of Isak, with Maguire getting across to try and get it away.
The ball looks like it is going in, but it hits the side of the net.
Trippier's corner deliveries have been fantastic in this match.
Lascelles gets there first and heads it down to centre-back partner Schar, but his powerful effort is blocked.
Joelinton and McTominay battle for the ball in the air, with the United man going down alleging that he used his elbow.
The referee ignores his claims.
HALF-TIME: NEWCASTLE UNITED 0-0 MANCHESTER UNITED
Newcastle have dominated against United, but this game is goalless at the break.
Garnacho's low shot towards the bottom corner early on in the match was the closest that the away side came to breaking the deadlock, with Pope sticking out a foot to deny the in-form Argentine.
Isak saw a goal-bound strike from close range deflect off the heel of Maguire.
Miley was also denied his first Magpies goal by Onana, who made an outstanding stop down to his right.
Trippier went close through a free-kick from the edge of the box, but his curling strike rattled the underside of the crossbar.
Newcastle should be ahead.
They have already had 14 shots in this match, accumulating an xG (expected goals) of 1.33.
Isak has been their main man in the attack and has registered three attempts, but he is yet to hit the target.
Livramento has also been instrumental with his runs down the left and will get an assist to his name if Rashford continues to neglect his defensive responsibilities.
As for United, they only had two shots in the half, with their last coming in the 13th minute.
The Red Devils passing accuracy of 75.2 per cent suggests they have gifted the hosts possession on too many occasions.
Martial has also been quiet and has not had a shot.
United get the ball rolling again through Fernandes.
There were no changes at the break.
Newcastle are patient in possession, with the hosts keeping it well before switching it over to Livramento.
He pushes through the edge of the box before finding Almiron, whose tame effort rolls straight to Onana.

Newcastle last lost a Premier League home match which was scoreless at half-time on October 30th 2021 (0-3 v Chelsea), which was also the same day that United last won an away match against a team that started the day in the top eight of the league (3-0 v Tottenham).
They have started this half well and have put the away side with a couple of dangerous crosses that have come to nothing.
Fernandes tries to spring United away on the counter, finding Martial on the left.
However, he has limited support around him and Newcastle get men back, forcing the Frenchman to return it to the midfield.
Trippier gets the better of Garnacho next to the corner flag and has the chance to put a cross into the box.
However, his delivery is poor and he gives it straight back to United.
Rashford needs some support on the left.
Livramento brushes past him with ease again but cannot make anything of the attack.
He finds Isak, who recycles possession.
Trippier has put a couple of poor crosses into the box in this half, but this one is perfect.
He rushes down the right and does not hesitate before driving the ball across the box and straight into the path of Gordon, who has the easiest of chances to score.
GOALLLL! GORDON SCORES! 1-0 NEWCASTLE! The hosts have a thoroughly deserved lead - that goal has definitely been coming.
Isak finds Guimaraes on the edge of the box, with the midfielder having the awareness to slide the ball down the right side of the box to Trippier.
His low first-time cross is met by Gordon, who has a simple finish from close range.
Newcastle have avoided defeat in their last seven matches when scoring the opening goal in the Premier League dating back to 27th August 2023 against Liverpool (losing 2-1).
Schar is not afraid of having a shot from range and tries his luck, but his straight effort goes just over the bar.
Ten Hag has seen enough and has decided to make a couple of changes.
Martial has been quiet in the attack and is being replaced up front by Hojlund, who is still searching for his first Premier League goal.
Rashford has had a game to forget on the wing for United.
He has not challenged full-back Livramento and has given him plenty of space to work with.
Antony is on in his place.
United have a deep free-kick and find Maguire with a cross into the box, but he heads well over the target.
Isak moves out to the right to receive possession, collecting it well before playing a pass inside to Guimaraes.
He darts into the box and looks for it back from the midfielder, but Maguire reads his intentions and makes an interception.
The ball is kicked off the pitch by Newcastle with Fernandes down holding his foot after a late tackle from Schar.
His reaction suggests that he is in some serious pain.
The home fans are not happy with the game being stopped.
Fernandes was treated by the medical staff and will be able to continue.
The game is back under way.
Trippier strolls forward with possession and approaches the box with options around him.
He is caught between a cross and a shot, sending the ball behind for a goal-kick.
Newcastle have a free-kick in a crossing position.
Trippier is over it, but the ball crashes against Garnacho and the hosts have it back.
Before it was taken, Fernandes was taking with Schar, probably discussing the late tackle from the centre-back earlier in the half.
Trippier is over another free-kick just inside United's half.
He pretends to take it to force the defence back before launching it towards the box, but Maguire is there to head it away.
United have the ball in Newcastle's half and are putting the hosts under pressure.
Fernandes drives a pass into Garnacho, but his touch is poor and Miley gets across to win it back.
Ten Hag's side have only had one shot in this half, with it being a wayward header from Maguire.
Maguire has been one of United's better players in this match but goes into the book for a late slide tackle on Gordon.
PENALTY SHOUT! Newcastle want a spot-kick! Joelinton gets down the left and drags a cross into the middle of the box.
Miley's shot is blocked by Wan-Bissaka and the hosts want a penalty, but their appeals are waived away.
United have struggled in this match, but it has not affected the performance of Mainoo, who has completed 92.3 per cent of his 39 passes.
He is coming off for Amrabat.
United make another two substitutes.
There is a change at full-back, with Reguilon coming on for Wan-Bissaka.
Shaw's outswinging corner from the left is headed away by Joelinton as far as Reguilon.
His first-time shot from the edge of the box looks to be heading into the corner, but Schar dives across to clear it away.
Pope went to save it and is now down.
He needs some medical assistance.
Pope cannot continue and is being helped off the pitch by the medical staff.
He comes off to a loud applause, with former United loanee Dubravka getting ready to come on.
Dubravka is picked ahead of Karius to replace Pope in goal.
He has four minutes plus additional time to keep a clean sheet.
Hojlund uses his physicality to push away challenges from the Newcastle defence before slotting a pass down the left side of the box to Garnacho.
It looks like he will have a chance to shoot, but Trippier slides across with a perfectly timed tackle.
OFFISDE! United have the ball in the net, but it won't count.
Maguire challenges for Reguilon's cross into the box, with the ball bouncing back to Antony.
His effort is heading on target, but it hits Maguire and deflects past Dubravka.
The flag then goes up for offside.
There will be nine minutes of additional time.
Livramento rushes down the left and gets the wrong side of Antony, who slides him to the floor and is shown a yellow card.
Garnacho cross on the left from the byline comes to nothing, with Trippier clearing the ball up the pitch.
Isak collects it around halfway and gets into a race with Amrabat, who slows him down before winning it back on the edge of United's box.
United have created very little in this match but have a chance through a free-kick from the left.
However, Fernandes' inswinging cross is poor, with Dubravka collecting it on the second attempt under pressure from Maguire.
Joelinton goes into the book for dissent.
Gordon has scored the only goal and is now coming off.
Howe's trusted man, Ritchie, comes on for the final few minutes.
Dalot looks to cause problems in Newcastle's box with a long throw-in, but the pressure is released when Amrabat lashes a wild shot over.
He then sticks his hand in the air to apologise.
FULL-TIME: NEWCASTLE UNITED 1-0 MANCHESTER UNITED
Gordon scored the only goal to help a dominant Newcastle side overcome United at St.
James' Park.
The Red Devils struggled throughout and only had two shots before the break.
Garnacho tested Pope with a low strike towards the near post, but the goalkeeper stuck his leg out to make a strong stop.
The Magpies controlled the rest of the half and should have scored.
Isak's effort from close range was deflected behind brilliantly by Maguire, with Miley also denied by a sharp stop from Onana.
Trippier went close, but his free-kick crashed the underside of the crossbar.
Newcastle's relentless pressure continued after the restart, with Gordon netting his fifth goal in eight games.
He raced into the box to get on the end of Trippier's low cross and tapped in for a simple finish.
United only had eight shots in the match but thought they had netted the equaliser when Reguilon's strike deflected off Maguire to beat substitute goalkeeper Dubravka.
However, the flag went up for offside.
Next up, Newcastle travel to Everton in the Premier League.
As for United, they host Chelsea.
That's all for today, goodbye.
